State of Kerala (Kerala High Court, 08.07.2019) is specifically about a request to raise the OBC Overseas Scholarship family-income slab and lists the 2014 scholarship GO as exhibit P2 and the 2018 creamy-layer GO as exhibit P3. This proves the documents were filed together in that litigation, not that the 2018 GO amended the overseas scholarship rules. Keep it as contextual/possibly relevant, not as a verified scheme amendment.
